title: Agents Feedback Plan
description: A selected feedback action plan that also tracks implementation progress.

schema_version.description: Plan schema identifier. Use feedback-plan.v1 for v1 plans.

objective.description: Concrete outcome this plan is intended to achieve.

owner.description: Primary owner expected to execute or coordinate the plan.

source_action_id.description: Identifier of the selected suggested action, or null when the plan did not originate from one action.

phases.description: Ordered groups of tasks used to execute and track the selected action.

outcome.description: Final or current outcome notes for the plan.

status.description: Outcome status for the selected action.

notes.description: Concise evidence or explanation of the plan outcome.

phase.description: A named execution phase in a feedback plan.

id.description: Stable phase identifier within this plan, such as phase-1.

task.description: A task or nested task used to execute and track feedback work.

id.description: Stable task identifier within its phase or parent task, such as task-1.

instructions.description: Concrete instructions needed to execute this task.

validation.description: How to prove this task was completed correctly.

evidence.description: Evidence gathered while executing or validating this task.

tasks.description: Optional nested tasks. Keep nesting shallow and promote large plans to normal repository docs.
